verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no URI scheme, deep links, or local endpoint for creating or opening notes in the Capacities app. The cloud REST API and MCP integration let external code read and write content, but that is a separate API story and does not let a script drive the app itself. The in-app command search and Cmd+U shortcut are internal UI features, not external control.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the app from outside — create or open notes via a URI scheme, deep links, or a local endpoint — to wire it into my scripts and workflows
